premise: Snail spends the whole day crossing the meadow to the pond — a grand expedition — and while Bird flies it in a blink and sees only grass, Snail arrives at sunset with the most to tell, and Bird asks to come along next time, slowly.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: not a race at all — the slow traveller sees the most, and the fast one wants to learn his way.
lesson: Going slowly lets you see what others miss.

en-US.title: Snail's Grand Expedition
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6} {sfx:meadow} One sunny morning, {snail:enter} Snail set off on a {snail:face happy} grand expedition: all the way across the meadow! {bird:enter} Bird swooped down. {bird:face happy} "I can do that in a blink!" {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Whoosh, to the pond… {bird:go back} and whoosh, back again. {snail:live hide} Snail ducked into his shell, then peeked out. [curious] "What did you see?" {bird:face surprised} "Um… grass?" [slowly] So Snail went his own way. Slowly. Slowly. {snail:pulse} He saw a daisy with a sunny middle. He saw a dewdrop, round as a marble. He met {bee:enter} {bee:go to snail} Bee, buzzing low over the clover, {bee:face happy} and she {bee:live hum} hummed him a tune so tiny that only a slow snail could hear it. {canvas:sunset 0.7} As the sun went down, {snail:go to pond} Snail reached the pond at last. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Bird flew over. "Well? What did you see?" {snail:live talk} Snail told him everything. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] "I didn't see any of that! [softly] Tomorrow, can I come too? Slowly?" {snail:face happy} {snail:live nod} [warmly] "Of course," said Snail. "We'll start with the daisy."

es-ES.title: La gran expedición de Caracol
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6} {sfx:meadow} Una mañana de sol, {snail:enter} Caracol salió de {snail:face happy} expedición: ¡a cruzar el prado entero! {bird:enter} Pájaro bajó en picado. {bird:face happy} —¡Eso lo hago yo en un periquete! {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Fiuuu, hasta la charca… {bird:go back} y fiuuu, de vuelta. {snail:live hide} Caracol se metió en su concha, y luego se asomó. [curious] —¿Y qué has visto? {bird:face surprised} —Eh… ¿hierba? [slowly] Así que Caracol siguió a su manera. Despacito. Despacito. {snail:pulse} Vio una margarita con el corazón de sol. Vio una gota de rocío, redonda como una canica. Y conoció a {bee:enter} {bee:go to snail} Abeja, que zumbaba bajito entre el trébol, {bee:face happy} y que le {bee:live hum} tarareó una canción tan chiquitita que solo un caracol, sin prisa, podía oírla. {canvas:sunset 0.7} Cuando el sol se ponía, {snail:go to pond} Caracol llegó por fin a la charca. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Pájaro se acercó volando. —¿Y bien? ¿Qué has visto? {snail:live talk} Caracol se lo contó todo. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Yo no he visto nada de eso! [softly] ¿Mañana puedo ir contigo? ¿Despacito? {snail:face happy} {snail:live nod} [warmly] —Claro —dijo Caracol—. Empezaremos por la margarita.

ja-JP.title: カタツムリくんの だいたんけん
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6}{sfx:meadow}あるはれたあさ、{snail:enter}カタツムリくんは、{snail:face happy}だいたんけんに出発しました。のはらのむこうまで、ずうっと！{bird:enter}ことりが、さっとおりてきて、{bird:face happy}「そんなの、あっというまだよ！」 {bird:go to pond}{sfx:whoosh}びゅーん、池まで…{bird:go back}びゅーん、もどってきました。{snail:live hide}カタツムリくんは、からにひっこんで、またひょっこり。[curious]「なにが見えた？」 {bird:face surprised}「えーと…くさ？」 [slowly]だからカタツムリくんは、じぶんのペースで。ゆっくり。ゆっくり。{snail:pulse}まんなかがお日さまいろの、ひなぎくを見ました。ビーだまみたいにまんまるな、あさつゆを見ました。クローバーの上をひくくとぶ{bee:enter}{bee:go to snail}ミツバチさんにも、あいました。{bee:face happy}ミツバチさんが{bee:live hum}うたってくれたのは、ゆっくりのカタツムリくんにしかきこえない、ちいさな、ちいさな歌。{canvas:sunset 0.7}お日さまがしずむころ、{snail:go to pond}カタツムリくんは、やっと池につきました。{bird:face happy}{bird:go to snail}ことりがとんできて、「で、なにが見えた？」 {snail:live talk}カタツムリくんは、ぜんぶはなしました。{bird:face surprised}[gasps]「ぼく、なんにも見てなかった！[softly]あした、ぼくもいっていい？ゆっくりで」 {snail:face happy}{snail:live nod}[warmly]「もちろん。まずは、ひなぎくからね」

de-DE.title: Die große Reise der Schnecke
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6} {sfx:meadow} An einem sonnigen Morgen brach {snail:enter} die Schnecke zu einer {snail:face happy} großen Entdeckungsreise auf: einmal quer über die ganze Wiese! {bird:enter} Der Vogel kam herabgesaust. {bird:face happy} „Das schaff ich ruck, zuck!“ {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Wusch, zum Teich… {bird:go back} und wusch, wieder zurück. {snail:live hide} Die Schnecke zog sich in ihr Haus zurück und lugte dann wieder hervor. [curious] „Was hast du gesehen?“ {bird:face surprised} „Äh… Gras?“ [slowly] Also ging die Schnecke ihren eigenen Weg. Langsam. Ganz langsam. {snail:pulse} Sie sah ein Gänseblümchen mit einer sonnengelben Mitte. Sie sah einen Tautropfen, rund wie eine Murmel. Sie traf {bee:enter} {bee:go to snail} die Biene, die tief über dem Klee summte, {bee:face happy} und die Biene {bee:live hum} summte ihr ein Lied, so winzig leise, dass nur eine langsame Schnecke es hören konnte. {canvas:sunset 0.7} Als die Sonne unterging, {snail:go to pond} kam die Schnecke endlich am Teich an. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Der Vogel flog herbei. „Na? Was hast du gesehen?“ {snail:live talk} Die Schnecke erzählte ihm alles. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] „Davon hab ich gar nichts gesehen! [softly] Darf ich morgen mitkommen? Langsam?“ {snail:face happy} {snail:live nod} [warmly] „Aber gern“, sagte die Schnecke. „Wir fangen beim Gänseblümchen an.“

fr-FR.title: La grande expédition d’Escargot
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6} {sfx:meadow} Un matin plein de soleil, {snail:enter} Escargot est parti pour une {snail:face happy} grande expédition : traverser tout le pré ! {bird:enter} Oiseau est descendu en piqué. {bird:face happy} « Moi, je fais ça en un clin d’œil ! » {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Et zou, jusqu’à la mare… {bird:go back} et zou, retour ! {snail:live hide} Escargot est rentré dans sa coquille, puis il a ressorti la tête. [curious] « Qu’est-ce que tu as vu ? » {bird:face surprised} « Euh… de l’herbe ? » [slowly] Alors Escargot a continué à sa façon. Tout doucement. Tout doucement. {snail:pulse} Il a vu une pâquerette au cœur de soleil. Il a vu une goutte de rosée, ronde comme une bille. Il a rencontré {bee:enter} {bee:go to snail} Abeille, qui bourdonnait au ras du trèfle, {bee:face happy} et elle lui {bee:live hum} a fredonné un air si petit, si petit, que seul un escargot qui prend son temps pouvait l’entendre. {canvas:sunset 0.7} Quand le soleil s’est couché, {snail:go to pond} Escargot est enfin arrivé à la mare. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Oiseau l’a rejoint en volant. « Alors ? Qu’est-ce que tu as vu ? » {snail:live talk} Escargot lui a tout raconté. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] « Moi, je n’ai rien vu de tout ça ! [softly] Demain, je peux venir avec toi ? Tout doucement ? » {snail:face happy} {snail:live nod} [warmly] « Bien sûr, a dit Escargot. On commencera par la pâquerette. »

it-IT.title: La grande spedizione di Chiocciola
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6} {sfx:meadow} Una mattina di sole, {snail:enter} Chiocciola è partita per una {snail:face happy} grande spedizione: attraversare tutto il prato! {bird:enter} Uccellino è sceso in picchiata. {bird:face happy} «Io lo faccio in un battibaleno!» {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Fiuuu, fino allo stagno… {bird:go back} e fiuuu, di nuovo qui. {snail:live hide} Chiocciola si è infilata nel guscio, poi ha fatto capolino. [curious] «Che cosa hai visto?» {bird:face surprised} «Ehm… l'erba?» [slowly] Così Chiocciola è andata a modo suo. Piano. Pianissimo. {snail:pulse} Ha visto una margherita col cuore di sole. Ha visto una goccia di rugiada, tonda come una biglia. Ha incontrato {bee:enter} {bee:go to snail} Ape, che ronzava bassa sul trifoglio, {bee:face happy} e che le ha {bee:live hum} canticchiato una canzoncina così piccina che solo una chiocciola lenta poteva sentirla. {canvas:sunset 0.7} Al tramonto, {snail:go to pond} Chiocciola è arrivata finalmente allo stagno. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Uccellino è volato da lei. «Allora? Che cosa hai visto?» {snail:live talk} Chiocciola gli ha raccontato tutto. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] «Io non ho visto niente di tutto questo! [softly] Domani posso venire anch'io? Piano piano?» {snail:face happy} {snail:live nod} [warmly] «Certo», ha detto Chiocciola. «Cominciamo dalla margherita.»

zh-TW.title: 蝸牛的大探險
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6}{sfx:meadow}一個晴朗的早上，{snail:enter}蝸牛出發去{snail:face happy}大探險：要走過整片草地！{bird:enter}小鳥咻地飛下來。{bird:face happy}「這個我一眨眼就做到了！」 {bird:go to pond}{sfx:whoosh}咻——飛到池塘……{bird:go back}再咻——飛回來。{snail:live hide}蝸牛縮進殼裡，又探出頭來。[curious]「你看到什麼了？」 {bird:face surprised}「呃……草？」 [slowly]於是，蝸牛照自己的方法走。慢慢地。慢慢地。{snail:pulse}牠看到一朵雛菊，中間黃黃的，像個小太陽。牠看到一顆露珠，圓得像彈珠。牠還遇見了{bee:enter}{bee:go to snail}蜜蜂，蜜蜂正貼著三葉草，低低地嗡嗡飛。{bee:face happy}蜜蜂{bee:live hum}哼了一首好小好小的歌給牠聽，小到只有慢慢走的蝸牛才聽得見。{canvas:sunset 0.7}太陽下山的時候，{snail:go to pond}蝸牛終於走到了池塘邊。{bird:face happy}{bird:go to snail}小鳥飛過來。「怎麼樣？你看到什麼了？」 {snail:live talk}蝸牛把看到的全都告訴牠。{bird:face surprised}[gasps]「這些我一個都沒看到！[softly]明天，我可以一起去嗎？慢慢地走？」 {snail:face happy}{snail:live nod}[warmly]「當然好。」 蝸牛說，「我們就從那朵雛菊開始。」

zh-HK.title: 蝸牛大探險
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6}{sfx:meadow}一個陽光普照的早上，{snail:enter}蝸牛出發去{snail:face happy}大探險：要走過整片草地！{bird:enter}小鳥飛了下來。{bird:face happy}「呢啲嘢，我眨下眼就做到啦！」 {bird:go to pond}{sfx:whoosh}嗖——飛到池塘……{bird:go back}再嗖——飛回來。{snail:live hide}蝸牛縮進殼裏，又探出頭來。[curious]「你見到啲乜嘢呀？」 {bird:face surprised}「呃……啲草？」 [slowly]於是，蝸牛用自己的方法走。慢慢地。慢慢地。{snail:pulse}牠看見一朵小雛菊，中間黃黃的，像個小太陽。牠看見一顆露珠，圓得像波子。牠還遇見了{bee:enter}{bee:go to snail}蜜蜂，蜜蜂正貼着三葉草低低地飛，{bee:face happy}還{bee:live hum}為牠哼了一首好細好細的歌——細得只有慢吞吞的蝸牛，才聽得見。{canvas:sunset 0.7}太陽下山的時候，{snail:go to pond}蝸牛終於來到池塘邊。{bird:face happy}{bird:go to snail}小鳥飛過來。「點呀？你見到啲乜嘢？」 {snail:live talk}蝸牛把看見的一切，一五一十地告訴牠。{bird:face surprised}[gasps]「我一樣都冇見到！[softly]聽日，我可唔可以一齊去？慢慢行？」 {snail:face happy}{snail:live nod}[warmly]「梗係得啦。」 蝸牛說，「我哋就由嗰朵小雛菊開始。」

meadow.prompt: a calm sunny meadow with distant birdsong and a bee buzzing now and then, realistic field recording

whoosh.prompt: a small bird flying fast past, quick fluttering wingbeats, realistic
